# awacino_device (Data Source)

One device, found by `id`, `name` or `external_id`. Key section **Connections** (Read).

With `wait_timeout` the data source waits until the device exists - use it with `depends_on` on the server that runs an `awacino_beamin_device` setup code in the same configuration, to get the registered device's id in one apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awacino_device" "nas" {
  name = "Office Hamburg - NAS"
}

# Wait for a server that registers during this apply (see awacino_beamin_device).
# data "awacino_device" "web01" {
#   external_id  = awacino_beamin_device.web01.external_id
#   wait_timeout = "15m"
#   depends_on   = [hcloud_server.web01]
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `external_id` (String) The external_id given at enrolment.
- `id` (String) Device id. Give exactly one of `id`, `name`, `external_id`.
- `name` (String) Exact device name (case-insensitive).
- `wait_timeout` (String) Wait up to this long (Go duration, for example `15m`) for the device to appear, polling with back-off 2 to 30 s. Without it a missing device is an error at once.

### Read-Only

- `first_seen` (String) First seen.
- `kind` (String) `app` or `unattended`.
- `last_seen` (String) Last seen (Beam-in devices).
- `member_id` (String) The member who registered it.
- `platform` (String) `macos`, `windows`, `linux`, `ios`, `android`, `docker`, ...
- `role` (String) `beamin` (can be reached) or `beamout` (connects out).
- `status` (String) `active` or `lobby`.
